2030: The main character of the series, called Serena in the English dub (nicknamed Bunny in the manga). Usagi is a carefree schoolgirl with an enormous capacity for love, and transforms into the heroine called Sailor Moon.
2366: A quiet bookworm in Usagi's class called Amy in the English adaptations of the series. She is hugely intelligent, with an IQ of 300, and can transform into Sailor Mercury, acquiring power over water.
2367: An elegant miko (shrine maiden), called Raye in the English version and Raya in the French version. Because of her work as a Shintô priestess, Rei can sense and dispel evil even in civilian form. When she transforms into Sailor Mars, she can also manipulate fire.
2825: Makoto is the third member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by Sailor Moon, and serves as the "muscles" of the group. In addition to being physically tough, she is able to manipulate electricity and uses some plant-based powers.
2826: Minako is the fourth member of the Sailor Team to be discovered by Sailor Moon, and serves as the leader of the Guardian Senshi who protect her. She uses love-related powers.
4013: Mamoru Chiba is the major romantic interest of Usagi Tsukino. He is often portrayed as stoic, steady and introverted.
5407: Luna was a talking cat and advisor to Usagi Tsukino. It was she who first detected Usagi's power, but at the time did not realize that she was the Moon Princess.
5408: Artemis is the companion to the leader of the Guardian Senshi—he trained Minako Aino as Sailor V, and remains by her side when she takes on her proper role as Sailor Venus.
6870: Naru starts the series as Usagi's best friend in school. Her mother owns a jewelry shop and she is the victim of several attacks by Youma.
8511: Queen Beryl is the first major villain in every version of the Sailor Moon series. She is the commander of the Dark Kingdom as well as the commander of the four Shitenou. During Silver Millennium, she led the invasion forces to conquer the Moon Kingdom.
8512: Jadeite is the first of the four Shitennou to appear, and the lowest in rank. He is the head of the Dark Kingdom's Far-Eastern Division. In the manga, Jadeite's mission was to track down the Silver Crystal but eventually led to gathering life energy to awaken Queen Metaria.
8513: Nephrite is the second of the Shitennou to appear, and the second-highest in rank. In the manga, Nephrite's primary goal was to locate the Silver Crystal.
8514: Zoisite is the third of the Shitennou, and is second-lowest in rank. In the manga, His first mission was to locate the Ginzuishou and follows several leads through news reports and press releases, but eventually switched his tactics to gathering energy instead.
8515: Kunzite is the fourth and final member of the Shitennou. He carries a shortsword, and is considered the most powerful general. He first appears aiding fellow general Zoisite. He is able to use powerful dark energy blasts, energy blades, and energy domes.
8544: Gurio is a smart nerd who is a classmate of Usagi and Naru at Juban Public MIddle School. He is usually called by his family name “Umino”. He keeps the sailor team up-to-date with information and rumors.
8904: Haruna is the junior high school teacher of Usagi at Juban Public Middle School. She can be quite strict towards Usagi’s laziness. However, she is also lovesick and obsessed with finding a husband, which makes her an easy target for the Dark Kingdom.
8905: Urawa is introduced as having the highest score in an exam, and secretly has powers that allow him to see the future, though it is unclear whether he used his powers to cheat. Urawa has feelings for Ami Mizuno, but is too shy to admit it.
8906: In the anime, Usagi calls him Motoki-oniisan and has a very big crush on him in the beginning of the series. He is also friends with Mamoru Chiba, who attends the same college he does, Azabu Institute of Technology. His girlfriend is Reika, a wonderful science student.
8908: Yuuichirou Kumada known as Chad Holdenford in the English version, is a ragged-looking young man who appears only in the anime, helping out at the Hikawa Shrine. In the English version, he talks like a surfer dude and calls himself a struggling musician.
8909: Queen Metaria is a malignant, amorphous energy being, similar to the depersonalized Japanese god of evil Amatsu-Mikaboshi. She was born as a result of radioactivity in the sun and is the true mastermind behind the Dark Kingdom.
12062: Grandpa Hino is Rei's lively and somewhat lecherous grandfather who is just as stubborn as Rei. Rei lives with him at his Shrine. He is a priest who is very skilled at martial arts. He is three feet tall, and has no hair.
17010: Queen Serenity was the queen of the Moon Kingdom during the Silver Millennium and the mother of Princess Serenity.
17937: Ikuko is kind of quirky and clueless regarding her daughter's extracurricular activities (just like her husband, Kenji). She's a housewife and very good cook, but is often frustrated with Usagi's bad grades, messiness, and laziness.
18345: Kenji is the Earth father of protagonist Usagi Tsukino (Sailor Moon). Kenji, like his wife Ikuko, is totally clueless about Usagi's real identity. A stereotypical well-meaning Japanese salaryman, he works as a magazine reporter and later as an editor-in-chief.
18346: Shingo is the obnoxious little brother of Usagi Tsukino, making her the only Sailor Senshi with any known siblings. His influence in her life is alternately helpful and mocking - he considers her well-meaning, but is a crybaby and a klutz.
18349: Reika is Motoki's girlfriend. She appears only twice in the anime series, and is the reincarnation of the Great Youma Rikokeidā. In the anime, she leaves Japan twice in order to study abroad, resulting in a long distance relationship between herself and Motoki.
25872: Petasos was a Youma owned by Nephrite. Her essence was implanted into the hat of Kunitachi, the caretaker at a local park that was scheduled to be demolished to make room for a business complex.
25873: Yasha was a Youma owned by Zoisite. She was sent to spy on Nephrite and steal the Silver Crystal if Nephrite was able to obtain it.
25874: Tesuni was a Youma owned by Nephrite. Her essence was implanted into the tennis racquet of Rui Saionji.
25876: Garoben was a Youma summoned by Jadeite to drain energy from unsuspecting students as part of the Dark Kingdom's continuing energy-gathering efforts. She appeared in anime episode 8.
25877: Kazuko Tadashita was an animator working on the Sailor V anime. She was Hiromi Matsuno's friend, and the two of them had bought a set of special pencils before they started working together, with the promise that they would not use them until they had become real pros.
25887: Mayumi Osaka was the name given to Naru's mother in Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon; in the other series she was never given a name. In all versions of Sailor Moon, she owned a jewelry shop, and was either replaced or possessed by a Youma who became Sailor Moon's first opponent.
25889: Hiromi Matsuno was an animator working on the Sailor V anime. She was targeted by Nephrite, who planted the twin Youma, Castor and Pollux, into her pencil.
25890: Nana Asahina was a photographer for a sleazy tabloid newspaper who managed to take a picture of the Sailor Senshi arguing and get it published. She tailed the Senshi to try and get a story out of them, and in the meantime was turned into Oniwabandana by Kunzite.
25892: Yumemi Yumeno was an anime only character. She was a popular artist in Tokyo, and many people believed that owning one of her illustrations could make their romantic dreams come true. In episode 28 she had Usagi and Mamoru model for one of her illustrations.
25894: Sakiko is a lonely young girl who lives with her father at Inaka-hama in Pension Adams, a large European-style hotel on the beach.
25899: Morga was a Youma summoned by Jadeite to drain energy from unsuspecting women as part of the Dark Kingdom's continuing energy-gathering efforts. She appeared in both the first anime episode as well as the first manga act.
25900: Flau was a Youma summoned by Jadeite to drain energy from unsuspecting radio-listeners as part of the Dark Kingdom's continuing energy-gathering efforts. She has a humanoid form with pale blue/purple skin, a blue toga, and unruly brown hair, with a dark star on her forehead.
25901: Iguara was a Youma summoned by Jadeite to drain energy from unsuspecting shopper looking for pets, as part of the Dark Kingdom's continuing energy-gathering efforts while posing as a pet shop owner at Pet Shop Perfume.
25902: Kyurene was a Youma summoned by Jadeite to drain energy from unsuspecting music-listeners as part of the Dark Kingdom's continuing energy-gathering efforts. She appeared in anime episode 6.
25903: Derella was a Youma summoned by Jadeite to drain energy from unsuspecting competitors as part of the Dark Kingdom's continuing energy-gathering efforts.
25904: Ramua was a Youma summoned by Jadeite to drain energy from unsuspecting shoppers as part of the Dark Kingdom's continuing energy-gathering efforts. She appeared in anime episode 9.
25906: Murid was a Youma owned by Jadeite. As part of the Dark Kingdom's continuing efforts to obtain energy, she posed as the mascot of the Dreamland amusement park, the "Dream Princess.
25907: Rui Saionji was a famous tennis player and she was Naru Osaka's childhood friend.
25910: Widow was a female youma under the control of Nephrite in episode 016. Her mission was to gather the energy of home economics teacher Higure Akiyama once she reached her peak energy output.
25913: The home economics teacher of Juuban Municipal Junior High School and taught Usagi, Naru, and Ami. She was engaged to be married but lacked self confidence.
25915: Cameran was a female youma under the control of Nephrite in episode 017. Her mission was to gather the energy of award-winning photographer Kijin Shinokawa once he reached his peak energy output. Cameran had lavender skin and wavy blue hair.
25918: A classmate of Shingo Tsukino. She makes dolls and won a French doll contest. Mika attends Juuban Primary School. Her mother is the famous doll maker Yoshiko Kayama.
25919: The Lake Monster was an ancient monster who appeared in episode 040. Although she was not a true youma, she is often considered to be one due to Endymion's attempt to use her in a way similar to the Dark Kingdom youma. She came from the lake near the Steamy Hot Springs Inn.
25920: Castor and Pollux are twin female youma under the control of Nephrite in episode 021 (Protect the Childrens' Dream! A Frienship Tied by Anime). Because they were Nephrite's strongest youma, their primary mission is to help him defeat the Sailor Senshi.
25921: Castor and Pollux are twin female youma under the control of Nephrite in episode 021 (Protect the Childrens' Dream! A Frienship Tied by Anime). Because they were Nephrite's strongest youma, their primary mission is to help him defeat the Sailor Senshi.
25923: Grape, Suzuran, and Housenka are a trio of youma under the control of Zoisite in episode 024 (Naru-chan's Tears! The Death of Nephrite for Love). Zoisite enlists their help to get the Kurozuishou from Nephrite.
25924: Grape, Suzuran, and Housenka are a trio of youma under the control of Zoisite in episode 024. Zoisite enlists their help to get the Kurozuishou from Nephrite.
25925: Grape, Suzuran, and Housenka are a trio of youma under the control of Zoisite in episode 024 (Naru-chan's Tears! The Death of Nephrite for Love). Zoisite enlists their help to get the Kurozuishou from Nephrite.
25927: Crane Game Joe appeared in episode 025 of the anime. In the beginning of the episode, the Kurozuishou revealed to Zoisite that Joe was the carrier of the red Nijizuishou. The next time he was seen was in Game Center Crown.
25995: Katarina was an Interpol officer and a friend of Minako who met her as Sailor V when she followed a Youma to London. She is one of the few civilians that are aware of a senshi's identity. While in London Katarina taught Minako English and acted like a big sister to her.
26048: Countess Rose was an English aristocrat who ran "Princess Seminars" for girls who wanted to learn etiquette and manners. She was turned into the Youma Shakoukai by Kunzite, and attempted to lure Sailor Moon to her Princess Seminars in order to discover her identity.
26049: The so-called "London Youma" was a youma from the Dark Kingdom who appeared in episode 042. He appeared on briefly in Minako's flashback of her time in London. Katarina was chasing a male criminal who took a child hostage and then turned into the "London Youma.
26050: Thetis is a female youma under the direct control of Queen Beryl in episode 012. Her mission is to help Jadeite gather energy from human beings in order to revive Queen Metallia. She is a very powerful youma who can control seawater.
26055: Saeko Yamamoto was a ski instructor who appeared in episode 038. She was the first woman to win the Moon Princess Contest at the Moonlight Course, and as such, she was also named hostess of the fourth annual contest which occurred in episode 038.
26057: Misha was a famous figure skater who, along with his partner, Janelyn, was possessed by Kunzite and forced into becoming part of a Dark Kingdom plan to find Sailor Moon.
26058: Janelyn was a famous figure skater who, along with her partner, Misha, was possessed by Kunzite and forced into becoming part of a Dark Kingdom plan to find Sailor Moon.
26060: The DD Girls were five youma who appeared in episode 045.
26062: Kariko Tokoyama was a famous hair dresser who appeared in episode 036. According to an article in a magazine that Usagi has, Kariko won the world hair design contest the previous month.
26068: Princess Dia was the shy spectacle-wearing princess of the D Kingdom (called Diamond Kingdom in the anime) who appeared in episode 22 of the anime series and Act 4 of the manga.
26069: Rhett Butler was an extremely large tomcat who had a crush on Luna. He was the reincarnation of Bakene, one of the Seven Great Youma, and was briefly transformed into his Youma form after Zoisite removed the Violet Rainbow Crystal from him.
26657: Kunitachi is a caretaker at a park in Tokyo who appears in episode 015. Ami takes Rei and Usagi to the park, and they meet Kunitachi there.
38051: Yuuji Kimura was a minor character from the anime. He was a student at Juuban Municipal Junior High School, and one of Usagi's classmates. He was also one of the victims hypnotized by Balm.
41229: Yumiko was a minor character who appeared in both the first season of the Sailor Moon anime and the first arc of the manga. She was a friend and classmate of Usagi and Naru at Juuban Municipal Junior High School.
41230: Kuri was a minor character who appeared in both the first season of the Sailor Moon anime and the first arc of the manga. She was a friend and classmate of Usagi and Naru at Juuban Municipal Junior High School.
41232: Mikan Shiratori was a former student at Juuban Municipal Junior High School who achieved fame as an idol. She was attacked and incapacitated by the Youma Derella, who assumed her identity in order to assist Jadeite with the Cinderella Caravan.
41641: Yusuke Amade was a famous jazz pianist who appeared in the first season of the anime. He accidentally got caught up in part of one of Jadeite's plots, and ended up being attacked by the Youma Kyurene.
41834: An employee at Jam Records, who Yusuke Amade secretly had a crush on. She is oblivious to Yusuke's feelings.
47317: An Ohara was a young girl who appeared in episode 31 of the Sailor Moon anime. An lived in Tokyo with her parents, and was the owner of a large tomcat named Rhett Butler.
